steps.title: If you would like, you can …
steps.text: If you would like, you can get 72 Mining, complete Making Friends with My Arm for an extra patch and teleports
steps.note: 3-tick mine granite (3t4g) at Bandit Camp Quarry / Cape Conch for fastest XP; no-tick: iron to 70 then Volcanic Mine. AFK: Motherlode Mine.
